title: 第2章  昨晚的事情，不许告诉任何人
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
叶长天冲进房间，已经彻底被情欲吞噬的夏秋水，直接毫不犹豫地朝他扑了过来……
一个时辰后。
叶长天感受着自己炼气四层巅峰的修为，仿佛如同做梦一般。
“卧槽，这就炼气四层巅峰了？”
要知道。
他现在这具身体，可是一个伪灵根的废物，来太玄宗当了三年杂役弟子，修为一直处于炼气一层。
现在与绝色掌门睡了一觉，瞬间就达到炼气四层巅峰！
这阴阳造化诀，简直逆天！
即便是他这种伪灵根的废物，竟然也能快速提升修为！
“唔……”
就在叶长天激动万分的时候，夏秋水嘴里突然发出了一阵奇怪的声音。
下一秒。
夏秋水一双迷离的眼眸渐渐恢复了清明。
她看着身下的叶长天，再看了看自己不着片缕的身体以及床榻上的一抹嫣红，咻地从叶长天身上爬了起来。
霎那间——
森然的寒意瞬间弥漫房间，仿佛要将空气都冻结似的。
一把泛着寒光的长剑，鬼魅般地抵在了叶长天的脖子上。
“蝼蚁，坏我清白之身，你想怎么死？”
叶长天感受到脖子上传来的凉意，身体瞬间僵硬了下来。
“掌……掌门息怒，我这也是为了救你啊。”

夏秋水面如寒霜。
她堂堂太玄宗掌门，竟然失身于杂役峰的一名杂役弟子。
最要命的是。
她体质与修炼功法都比较特殊，在突破元婴之上的化神境前，是不能破身的。
一旦破身，轻则走火入魔，重则修为尽失。
后果不堪设想！
只是——
当夏秋水查看了自己身体情况后，下一秒直接愣住了。
她没有任何走火入魔的迹象，一身元婴巅峰的修为不仅没有失去，反而精进了不少。
本来在这以前。
夏秋水想要从元婴巅峰冲击化神境，至少都还需要三五年的积累。
可现在夏秋水感觉自己半只脚都已经跨进去了。
只需给她一点时间，她就有信心成为真正的化神强者！
“怎……怎么可能？”
夏秋水看着面前的叶长天，清冷的眸子中终于浮现出了一抹难以掩饰的惊骇。
与这家伙双修，竟然能改变自己体质与功法的缺点！
要不要这么离谱？
眼前这个杂役弟子，身上有大秘密啊。
夏秋水嘴角顿时勾起一抹动人心魄的弧度，手中长剑将叶长天的下巴挑了起来。
“掌门，你……你要干嘛？”

叶长天顿时只感觉头皮一阵发麻。
夏秋水一双美眸直直地盯着叶长天：“昨天晚上的事情，我不希望有第三个人知道，明白吗？”
“明……明白。”
“掌门放心，我叶长天对天发誓，哪怕就算是死，也绝不会向任何人透露半个字的。”
叶长天点头如小鸡啄米似的。
不用夏秋水交代，他也绝对半个字都不敢透露出去啊。
夏秋水才貌双绝，不仅是太玄宗有史以来最年轻的元婴境大佬，更是北域第一美人，也是太玄宗无数男弟子的梦中情人。
要是让这些男弟子知道他把夏秋水给睡了，叶长天都无法想象他的下场会有多惨。
夏秋水看了叶长天一眼，没有再多说什么。
她抬手一挥，手中长剑鬼魅消失。
可就在她刚要准备离开的时候，门口却是传来一阵咚咚咚的敲门声。
紧接着。
门外响起了一道有些不耐烦的女子声音。
“叶长天，开门，再不开门我就自己进来了。”
叶长天听到门外的声音，顿时就麻了。
“这不是我那便宜未婚妻么，她怎么这个时候来了？”
“掌门，快……快躲起来。”
叶长天说着，眼疾手快地将夏秋水拉上了床，藏在了被子里面。
与此同时。
房间的大门被人砰地一脚踹开了。

只见一位约莫二十来岁的紫裙女子大步从门外走了进来。
女子五官精致，一双迷人的丹凤眼，典型的短剧古装美女打扮，一身紫色长裙的V字领口开得很深，露出大片大片的雪白，足以见得她非常孝顺，将奶奶照顾得很好。
而被叶长天拉入被子里的夏秋水，整个人都在这一刻僵住了。
她堂堂元婴境强者，本来是可以瞬移离开的，却没想到叶长天出手这么突然，直接给她拉到了被子里。
现在叶长天未婚妻已经闯进房间，离开根本来不及了。
她可是堂堂太玄宗掌门，如今竟然跟门下弟子的未婚夫睡在了一起。
这要是被捉奸在床，她以后还有何脸面见人？
夏秋水强压下心中的慌乱，连忙凝神屏气，一动不动地蜷缩在被子里。
“柳紫嫣，虽然你是我的未婚妻，可大半夜的这么闯入我的房间，似乎也不太好吧？”
叶长天看着闯入房间的柳紫嫣，面色显得有些不太好看。
柳嫣然，原主的未婚妻。
十多年前。
柳嫣然背后的柳家遭遇危机，为了得到叶家的相助，于是让柳嫣然与他联姻。
原主对于柳嫣然，也的确迷恋得无可自拔，乃是柳嫣然身边最忠实的舔狗，以叶家少主的身份为柳嫣然提供了无数修炼资源。
可柳嫣然对于叶长天这个伪灵根的废材，打心底就瞧不起。
尤其在三年前进入太玄宗后。
柳嫣然成为了太玄宗的内门弟子，并且得到太玄宗圣子的青睐，很快就与太玄宗那位圣子勾搭在一起。
为了解决与叶长天有婚约的黑历史，与太玄宗圣子光明正大在一起，柳嫣然不止一次找叶长天退婚，可原主这个舔狗死活不肯退婚。
柳嫣然又不想将这事闹得人尽皆知，所以一直拖延到了现在。
“叶长天，我为什么来找你你应该心知肚明。”

“你一个杂役弟子，伪灵根的废物，与我早已不是一个世界人，我是不可能嫁给你这个废物的，你也别妄想癞蛤蟆吃天鹅肉了。”
“若是你主动解除婚约，我或许还能给你留几分体面。”
柳嫣然冷冷地说道。
叶长天听得柳嫣然的话，顿时笑了。
“柳嫣然，你真要退婚？”
舔狗舔狗，舔到最后果然是一无所有。
不过——
他早就不是曾经那个叶长天，又岂会没下限地去跪舔柳嫣然这样的女人？
“没错，这次你别妄想给我一点灵石资源，跪下来求我我就会心软，今天这婚我退定了！”
柳嫣然一脸坚决之色。
她之所以一直没有与叶长天解除婚约，除了不想将此事闹大，主要就是每次提退婚的时候，叶长天就拿出一笔修炼资源，哭着求她不要退婚。
看在修炼资源的份上，柳嫣然一次又一次忍耐了下来。
如今叶长天的价值几乎已经被他榨干，圣子哥哥也明确表示要娶她。
所以——
她与叶长天之间，必须有个了结。
“求你？”
“柳嫣然，你未免也太看得起你自己了，你真当这世上没女人了，老子非得在你这一棵树上吊死？”
“你要退婚，我成全你，不过这些年我花在你身上的资源至少价值上万灵石，把灵石全都还给我，你我从此以后桥归桥，路归路，再无瓜葛！”
叶长天摆了摆手，一脸不耐烦地说道。
他可不是原主那个舔狗。

退婚可以，但老子花在你身上的灵石，你得一分不少地吐出来才行！
你与太玄宗圣子搞在一起就牛逼了？
老子还跟太玄宗掌门睡了呢。
据他所知，如今的太玄宗圣子，就是掌门夏秋水的弟子。
一日为师，终身为父。
夏秋水现在就相当于太玄宗圣子的半个父亲。
他现在有阴阳造化诀这门大杀器，未必就不能把夏秋水睡服！
只要睡服了夏秋水，太玄宗圣子在他面前都是晚辈！
到时候。
柳嫣然要是嫁给太玄宗圣子，他非得让这女人跪下来叫爸爸！
content_en:
Ye Changtian rushed into the room, and Xia Qiushui, who had been completely swallowed by lust, rushed towards him without hesitation...
An hour later.
Ye Changtian felt his cultivation at the peak of the fourth level of Qi refining, as if he was in a dream.
"Damn it, is this the peak of the fourth level of Qi refining?"
To know.
His current body is a waste with pseudo-spiritual roots. He has been a handyman disciple of Taixuan Sect for three years, and his cultivation has always been at the first level of Qi refining.
Now, after sleeping with the stunning leader, I reached the peak of the fourth level of Qi refining in an instant!
This yin and yang creation technique is simply heaven-defying!
Even a waste like him with pseudo-spiritual roots can actually improve his cultivation level quickly!
"Well..."
Just when Ye Changtian was extremely excited, Xia Qiushui suddenly made a strange sound from his mouth.
The next second.
Xia Qiushui's blurred eyes gradually regained their clarity.
She looked at Ye Changtian beneath her, then at her naked body and the bright red on the bed, and then got up from Ye Changtian's body.
All of a sudden——
A deep chill instantly filled the room, as if it was freezing the air.
A long sword with a cold light was pressed against Ye Changtian's neck like a ghost.
"You ant, you have ruined my innocence. How do you want to die?"
Ye Changtian felt the coolness on his neck, and his body stiffened instantly.
"Master...master, please calm down, I am here to save you."
In summer and autumn, the water surface is like frost.
She, the majestic head of Taixuan Sect, unexpectedly lost her virginity to a handyman disciple at the Miscellaneous Peak.
The most terrible thing is.
Her physique and cultivation techniques are quite special, and she cannot break her body before breaking through to the realm of spirit transformation above Nascent Soul.
Once one's body is broken, one may become obsessed with it, or one may lose all one's cultivation.
The consequences are disastrous!
Just——
When Xia Qiushui checked her physical condition, she was stunned for a second.
She showed no signs of going crazy. Not only did she not lose her peak Nascent Soul cultivation, she actually improved a lot.
It was before this.
If Xia Qiushui wants to reach the realm of transformation from the peak of Nascent Soul, it will take at least three to five years of accumulation.
But now Xia Qiushui felt that half of her feet had already stepped in.
Just give her a little time and she will have the confidence to become a real powerful person!
"How...how is it possible?"
Xia Qiushui looked at Ye Changtian in front of him, and a hint of horror that could not be concealed finally appeared in his cold eyes.
Practicing double cultivation with this guy can actually change the shortcomings of your own physique and skills!
Is it so outrageous?
The handyman disciple in front of me has a big secret.
The corners of Xia Qiushui's mouth suddenly curved in a touching arc, and the long sword in his hand lifted up Ye Changtian's chin.
"Master, you...what do you want to do?"
Ye Changtian suddenly felt his scalp numb.
Xia Qiushui stared straight at Ye Changtian with her beautiful eyes: "I don't want a third person to know about what happened last night, do you understand?"
"Ming...understand."
"Don't worry, Master. I, Ye Changtian, swear to God that even if I die, I will never reveal a word to anyone."
Ye Changtian nodded like a chicken pecking at rice.
There was no need for Xia Qiushui to explain, and he would never dare to reveal even a single word.
Xia Qiushui is both talented and beautiful. Not only is she the youngest Nascent Soul Realm boss in the history of Taixuan Sect, she is also the most beautiful woman in the Northern Territory and the dream lover of countless male disciples of Taixuan Sect.
If these male disciples knew that he had slept with Xia Qiushui, Ye Changtian could not imagine how miserable his end would be.
Xia Qiushui glanced at Ye Changtian and said nothing more.
She raised her hand and waved it, and the ghostly sword in her hand disappeared.
But just when she was about to leave, there was a knock on the door.
Immediately afterwards.
An impatient female voice sounded outside the door.
"Ye Changtian, open the door. If you don't open the door, I will come in by myself."
Ye Changtian heard the sound outside the door,I felt numb immediately.
"Isn't this my cheap fiancée? Why is she here at this time?"
"Master, quickly... hide quickly."
Ye Changtian said, quickly pulling Xia Qiushui onto the bed and hiding her under the quilt.
at the same time.
The door to the room was kicked open with a bang.
I saw a woman in a purple skirt, about twenty years old, striding in from the door.
The woman has exquisite facial features, a pair of charming phoenix eyes, and is dressed like a typical short-drama costume beauty. The V-shaped neckline of her purple dress is very deep, revealing a large swath of snow-white skin, which shows that she is very filial and takes good care of her grandma.
Xia Qiushui, who was pulled into the quilt by Ye Changtian, froze at this moment.
She was a powerful Nascent Soul Realm person who could have teleported away, but she didn't expect Ye Changtian to make such a sudden move and pull her directly into the quilt.
Now Ye Changtian's fiancée has broken into the room, and it's too late to leave.
She is the head of Taixuan Sect, and now she is sleeping with the fiancé of her disciple.
If she was caught in bed, how would she have the face to see anyone in the future?
Xia Qiushui suppressed the panic in her heart, quickly held her breath, and curled up motionless in the quilt.
"Liu Ziyan, although you are my fiancée, it doesn't seem right to break into my room like this in the middle of the night, right?"
Ye Changtian looked at Liu Ziyan who broke into the room, his face looked a little unhappy.
Liu Yanran, the fiancée of the original owner.
More than ten years ago.
The Liu family behind Liu Yanran was in crisis, so in order to get help from the Ye family, Liu Yanran was asked to marry him.
The original owner was indeed obsessed with Liu Yanran. He was the most loyal licking dog around Liu Yanran. As the young master of the Ye family, he provided Liu Yanran with countless training resources.
But Liu Yanran despised Ye Changtian, a useless person with fake spiritual roots, from the bottom of her heart.
Especially after entering Taixuan Sect three years ago.
Liu Yanran became an inner disciple of Taixuanzong and gained the favor of the saintly son of Taixuanzong. She soon hooked up with the saintly son of Taixuanzong.
In order to resolve the dark history of her engagement with Ye Changtian and live openly with the Holy Son of Emperor Taixuan, Liu Yanran asked Ye Changtian to break off the engagement more than once, but the original owner, a licking dog, refused to break off the engagement.
Liu Yanran didn't want to make this matter known to everyone, so she kept delaying it until now.
"Ye Changtian, you should know why I came to you."
"You are a handyman disciple and a waste with fake spiritual roots. You are no longer in the same world as me. There is no way I would marry a waste like you. Don't even think about eating swan meat like a toad."
"If you take the initiative to terminate the engagement, I might be able to save you some dignity."
Liu Yanran said coldly.
Ye Changtian smiled immediately after hearing Liu Yanran's words.
"Liu Yanran, do you really want to break off the engagement?"
Licking the dog, licking the dog, in the end there will be nothing left.
But——
He is no longer the Ye Changtian he once was, so how could he kneel down and lick a woman like Liu Yanran without any limit?
"That's right, don't try to give me any spiritual stone resources this time. If you kneel down and beg me, I will relent. I will cancel the marriage today!"
Liu Yanran looked determined.
The reason why she had not terminated her engagement with Ye Changtian was not only because she did not want to make the matter a big deal, but also because every time she proposed to break off the engagement, Ye Changtian would use a sum of cultivation resources and cry to her not to break off the engagement.
For the sake of training resources, Liu Yanran endured it again and again.
Now that Ye Changtian's value has been almost squeezed out by him, Brother Shengzi has also made it clear that he wants to marry her.
So——
There must be an end between her and Ye Changtian.
"Please?"
"Liu Yanran, you think too highly of yourself. Do you really think that there are no women in this world and I have to hang myself on your tree?"
"If you want to break off the engagement, I will grant it to you, but the resources I have spent on you over the years are at leastIt’s worth tens of thousands of spiritual stones. Return all the spiritual stones to me. From now on, we will have nothing to do with each other! "
Ye Changtian waved his hand and said impatiently.
He is not the licking dog of the original owner.
You can break off the engagement, but you have to spit out every cent of the spiritual stones I spent on you!
Are you awesome if you get together with the Holy Son of Taixuanzong?
I even slept with the head of Taixuanzong.
As far as he knew, the current Holy Son of Taixuan Sect was the disciple of the head Xia Qiushui.
Once a teacher, always a father.
Xia Qiushui is now equivalent to half the father of the Holy Son of Taixuan Sect.
Now that he has the Yin-Yang Creation Art, a powerful weapon, he may not be able to sleep with Xia Qiushui!
As long as he sleeps with Xia Qiushui, the Holy Son of Taixuanzong will be a junior in front of him!
That's when.
If Liu Yanran marries the Holy Son of Taixuan Sect, he will have to make this woman kneel down and call her daddy!
